freeze_status: before any study corpus metric computation
semantic_contract: original dynamic VUS: sum-clip sqrt ramps, overlap-only merged coverage, P=P0+B/2, clipped recall times coverage, complete numerical ties, right-step PR, mean every integer width 0..L
score_policy: original published finite stored values; no rescaling, repair, tie splitting, padding, smoothing, or changed direction
upstream_parity: H250, all selected series, all twelve models, all three widths; absolute tolerance 2e-10
exact_validation: top two retained series per source family in the frozen acquisition hash order; all twelve models; primary L30; compare independent dense exact and unmodified Klein H=n with radix exact at absolute tolerance 2e-10
winner_policy: all models within tie_tolerance of maximum; report best-case and worst-case exact regret of sampled winner set; lexical choice secondary
top3_policy: include every model within tolerance of the third-largest value
pair_reversal_policy: strict opposite signs with both absolute margins greater than tie_tolerance; separately count both margins >=0.01
kendall_policy: tau-b with tolerance-defined pair ties; undefined denominator reported null

promotion_gate.interpretation: declared practical study criterion, not a venue acceptance rule

bootstrap.unit: source family (all its series retained together)
bootstrap.primary_statistic: fraction of series with best-case regret >=0.01

parent_dependence: source family clustering is conservative but does not establish independent parent recordings; no known parent map, no invented parent grouping

timing.subset: first two retained per source family, sorted by SHA256(msad-vus-20261023-v1\0 + family/filename), same subset as exact validation
timing.method_order: independently permuted each case and repetition by seeded RNG 20261023

outputs.dense_exact: ROC+PR internally; returned PR; extra-output work explicitly retained

timing.scope: complete call including validation, preparation, sorting and all widths; excludes source decode/import; separate collection wall time includes decode/evaluation/report write
timing.warmup: all methods on a fixed non-study synthetic input before timing
timing.timeout_policy: retain censored/failure record; no favorable deletion or parameter substitution
timing.concurrency: begin only after acquisition and other heavy tests have stopped
timing.summary: per-case method medians over successful paired reps; report missing/censored coverage; comparator/radix ratios, geometric means, medians, equal-family and family bootstrap

source_freeze: write immutable source-hash manifest binding protocol, acquisition manifest, runner and called implementation files before first corpus metric
records: append-only JSONL, resume by unique phase/case/model/width/budget/method/repetition key; reject conflicting duplicate keys and changed source/data hashes
negative_result_policy: retain every selected case, source quantization statistic, exclusion, failure, timeout and failed gate; do not tune widths or replace the panel based on outcomes
